title: vatica stapfiana
intro: Vatica stapfiana, commonly known as the Borneo ironwood, is a plant species in the family Dipterocarpaceae. It has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and diarrhea. The health benefits of Vatica stapfiana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Vatica stapfiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential health benefits.
